examples.text: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a creature card from among them onto the battlefield. If that card has mana value 2 or less, it enters with two additional +1/+1 counters on it. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

Look at the top four cards of your library. You may put a creature card from among them onto the battlefield. If that card has mana value 4 or less, it enters with four additional +1/+1 counters on it. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

counterExamples: Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a creature card from among them onto the battlefield. If that card has mana value 2 or more, it enters with two additional +1/+1 counters on it. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

Look at the top five cards of your library. You may put a creature card from among them into your hand. If that card has mana value 2 or less, it enters with two additional +1/+1 counters on it. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
